name: Template / Prompt Format
description: Compose prompt text with Jinja-style variables such as {{ summary }} and {{ keywords | join(", ") }}, or legacy {name} format placeholders.

inputs.name: variables
inputs.description: Variable map input. Connect one or more JSON objects with {name: value} pairs.

parameters.name: template_engine
parameters.description: Template engine. Use jinja2 for {{ variable }} syntax or format for legacy {variable} syntax.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Prompt template text. In Jinja mode this is used as the user section when user_template is empty.

parameters.name: system_template
parameters.description: Optional system prompt section rendered with Jinja syntax.

parameters.name: user_template
parameters.description: Optional user prompt section rendered with Jinja syntax.

parameters.name: reusable_blocks
parameters.description: Reusable snippets available under the blocks variable.

parameters.name: strict_variables
parameters.description: Raise an error when a Jinja variable is missing.
